name: Connecticut College Invitational
where: Waterford, CT · host Connecticut College · Harkness Memorial State Park
headline: Connecticut College: MIT wins the men's showdown
summary: Men's Blue race: No. 10 MIT won with 57 points, ahead of No. 16 Williams (120), No. 21 Wesleyan (173), No. 15 Tufts (196) and No. 29 Bates (197), and Wesleyan's Dylan Cote won in 23:52.8. Women's Blue race: No. 8 Middlebury beat No. 1 Williams 63-65, with No. 6 Tufts third (131), and Middlebury's Audrey Maclean won in 20:36.6. MIT also won the men's White race (52) and Williams the women's White race (25).
